purpose: Characterize correction/retention beyond the inherited opening-only corpus after C3 drains. No competitive games or strength inference.
sourceQualification: Completed64 normal C1 games,8780 request audits passed; source hash recorded at selection. Never read C3 partial scores or either frozen BOUNDARY2 study.
selection: Take exactly these game/prefix combinations when the prefix exists and is nonterminal; skip unavailable/terminal only, list all reasons. No win/loss/score/evaluator filtering or replacement sampling. Preserve original start and full legal history. At most24 roots. Report material/phase distribution; depth of play is not proof of endgame coverage.
sequence: Existing harness visits final prefix minus4/minus2/0 plies with one driver and no new-game between; all complete real histories retained. Fresh driver per root/profile.
stop: No concurrent match;60s per request/600s per domain; fail invariant or W1 clean/observed mismatch, preserve all output.
limits: C1-generated histories are exploratory and candidate-dependent; no independent phase/strength claim. This diagnoses active signal, bounds/reset/drain and possible context aliasing, not true score labels.
